comment: Read from the source at tag 2.1.2 (commit d57e97e), which is the installed build. The module adds nothing to Rack's right-click menu, so there are no menu lines. The pink filter is Paul Kellet's economy version, coefficients at lines 54-60; the 0.11 scaling at line 60 is what matches its level to the white path. The sample and hold input is given no family because it carries whatever is patched to it. The maker's summary calls the module a white and pink noise source with sample and hold, which the code matches.
